dre.text: Listen, yeah. Man's been on this block from time, ya get me. Nuffin shocks me no more. I just stay calm, innit.

lou.text: Bruv, you lot ain't ready for this one, ya know! Man was there, innit, I saw it with my own eyes. Allow it, fam, that's mad!

fast.text: Yo, wagwan fam! Bruv, you lot will not believe what just happened, ya know! Man's gone mad, innit, listen, listen!

boss.text: Right then, my friend. Twenty years I have stood behind this counter, and every night it is the same story. Chicken, chips, and nobody ever has the money.

cop.text: Stop right there, the pair of you! You are not going anywhere tonight. Get back here now, and keep your hands where I can see them!
